description:
The table presents a thematic accuracy assessment for eight Land Cover / Land Use (LULC) classes, designated as Class 1 through Class 8, likely corresponding to Level 1 of the nomenclature for Protected Areas products.

The primary section is a confusion matrix comparing MAP classifications (rows) against REFERENCE classifications (columns). Values represent quantities (e.g., area or sample points) in an unspecified unit, showing correctly classified instances on the diagonal (highlighted).
The total quantity across all reference classes is 36994.0.

| MAP Class \ Reference Class | Class 1 | Class 2 | Class 3 | Class 4 | Class 5 | Class 6 | Class 7 | Class 8 | Total (MAP) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Class 1 | 536.8 | 3.0 | 24.2 | 19.7 | 7.9 | 3.0 | 1.0 | - | 595.6 |
| Class 2 | 25.9 | 3394.4 | 218.2 | 462.5 | 110.6 | 5.0 | 7.0 | 1.0 | 4224.6 |
| Class 3 | 30.9 | 32.9 | 16305.3 | 65.8 | 168.5 | 6.0 | 35.9 | 8.0 | 16653.2 |
| Class 4 | 73.3 | 254.5 | 287.2 | 5625.4 | 337.7 | 56.4 | 131.7 | 7.9 | 6774.3 |
| Class 5 | 12.0 | 50.9 | 284.3 | 255.4 | 2990.0 | 71.8 | 9.0 | 3.0 | 3676.3 |
| Class 6 | 1.1 | 12.3 | 24.5 | 71.8 | 94.1 | 1160.7 | 4.5 | 1.1 | 1370.2 |
| Class 7 | 3.0 | 2.0 | 55.7 | 135.7 | 266.4 | 14.2 | 1225.6 | 35.4 | 1738.2 |
| Class 8 | 5.0 | - | 9.9 | 6.0 | 5.0 | 4.0 | 11.9 | 1920.0 | 1961.8 |
| Total (Reference) | 688.0 | 3750.1 | 17209.4 | 6642.3 | 3980.1 | 1321.1 | 1426.6 | 1976.4 | 36994.0 |

The table also provides class-specific and overall accuracy metrics with 95% Confidence Intervals (CI95%):

| Class | Producer Accuracy (Prod θ) | Omission Error | CI95% (Producer) | User Accuracy (User λ) | Commission Error (Com.) | CI95% (User) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Class 1 | 78.02% | 21.98% | 2.75% | 90.13% | 9.87% | 2.37% |
| Class 2 | 90.52% | 9.48% | 0.89% | 80.35% | 19.65% | 1.20% |
| Class 3 | 94.75% | 5.25% | 0.32% | 97.91% | 2.09% | 0.22% |
| Class 4 | 84.69% | 15.31% | 0.78% | 83.04% | 16.96% | 0.89% |
| Class 5 | 75.12% | 24.88% | 1.16% | 81.33% | 18.67% | 1.26% |
| Class 6 | 87.86% | 12.14% | 1.66% | 84.72% | 15.28% | 2.01% |
| Class 7 | 85.91% | 14.09% | 1.70% | 70.51% | 29.49% | 2.16% |
| Class 8 | 97.14% | 2.86% | 0.72% | 97.87% | 2.13% | 0.64% |

Overall Accuracy (OA): 89.63% (CI95%: 0.30%)

Producer accuracy (Prod θ) indicates how much of each real-world land cover class was correctly detected; User accuracy (User λ) indicates how reliable each classified pixel is; Omission error is the proportion of real features missed; Commission error is the proportion of false detections; CI95% represents the 95% confidence interval for the accuracy estimate.
The overall accuracy for the product is 89.63%. Class 3 exhibits the highest User Accuracy (97.91%) and Producer Accuracy (94.75%) with the lowest Omission and Commission errors, while Class 7 has the lowest User Accuracy (70.51%) and highest Commission Error (29.49%), and Class 5 has the lowest Producer Accuracy (75.12%) and highest Omission Error (24.88%).
